source: Fixture for issue 470: a test that passes only through an external tool's failure path from the architecture review of a real triage run on a 15-file Go package (#468). setAnnounced at prober.go:55 sets the v6 gauge from v4 on purpose: the success-path defect the failure-path test hides.

candidates.claim: InstanceProber.reconcile runs the birdc CLI through exec.Command with no seam; the tests shadow PATH with a stub birdc that exits 1, so TestInstanceProber_v6FailDrainsOnlyV6 passes through the configure-failure branch, not the behaviour it names. Put the diff, the ready.conf write, the reconfigure and the announced gauge in one readyExporter behind a birdc adapter.
candidates.removes: a per-address-family test that never reaches the path a working birdc takes

candidates.claim: The comment on InstanceProber.Set says tick() calls it; the package has no tick().
